name: Splunk
description: Connect your own Splunk instance (self-hosted or Splunk Cloud) to run searches, manage saved searches/alerts, indexes, users and roles, send events via HTTP Event Collector, and audit search-head health -- from Imperal. Uses your own auth token (or username/password) -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself.

tools.name: connect_splunk
tools.description: Connect your own self-hosted or Splunk Cloud instance by saving its base URL plus an auth token or username/password, after checking it actually works. Get a token from Splunk: Settings > Tokens > New Token.

base_url.description: Your Splunk management API base URL, e.g. https://splunk.mycompany.com:8089
base_url.title: Base Url

auth_token.description: Splunk auth token (Settings > Tokens > New Token).
auth_token.title: Auth Token

label.description: Optional friendly name for this connection.
label.title: Label

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Splunk instances.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: disconnect_splunk
tools.description: Disconnect a Splunk instance: deletes the saved credentials. Nothing in Splunk itself is changed.

tools.name: save_hec_token
tools.description: Save an HTTP Event Collector token for a connected Splunk instance, so send_event can push events into it. Get one from Settings > Data Inputs > HTTP Event Collector > New Token.

connection_id.description: Connection id this HEC token belongs to.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

hec_token.description: HTTP Event Collector token (Settings > Data Inputs > HTTP Event Collector).
hec_token.title: Hec Token

label.description: Optional friendly name, e.g. the target index.
label.title: Label

tools.name: list_hec_tokens
tools.description: List saved HTTP Event Collector tokens (never reveals the secret value).

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: delete_hec_token
tools.description: Permanently delete a saved HEC token. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: dispatch_search
tools.description: Start a new Splunk search job (SPL query). Returns a search job id (sid) -- poll get_search_status, then get_search_results once done.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

spl_query.description: Splunk SPL query, e.g. 'search index=security sourcetype=auth | stats count by user'
spl_query.title: Spl Query

tools.name: get_search_status
tools.description: Read a search job's current status -- whether it's done, and scan/event/result counts so far.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_search_results
tools.description: Read a page of results from a completed (or still-running) search job.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: cancel_search
tools.description: Cancel a running search job.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_saved_searches
tools.description: List saved searches (and alerts) configured on the connected Splunk instance.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_saved_search
tools.description: Create a new saved search, optionally with a cron schedule to run it as an alert.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

search.description: SPL query for this saved search.
search.title: Search

cron_schedule.description: Cron schedule, e.g. '*/15 * * * *'; empty = not scheduled.
cron_schedule.title: Cron Schedule

is_scheduled.description: Whether this saved search runs on a schedule.
is_scheduled.title: Is Scheduled

tools.name: update_saved_search
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing saved search. Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: Permanently delete a saved search. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: dispatch_saved_search
tools.description: Run a saved search right now, on demand, regardless of its schedule.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

name.description: Saved search name to run now.
name.title: Name

tools.name: list_indexes
tools.description: List indexes configured on the connected Splunk instance, with current/max size.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users registered on the connected Splunk instance.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List roles configured on the connected Splunk instance, with their capabilities.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: send_event
tools.description: Send an event into Splunk via HTTP Event Collector (HEC). Requires a saved HEC token (save_hec_token).

event.description: Event payload text or JSON to ingest.
event.title: Event

index.description: Target index; empty = HEC token's default index.
index.title: Index

tools.name: audit_search_head
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report for the connected Splunk instance: saved searches without an alert action, and indexes near their size quota.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: splunk_connections
secrets.description: Your connected Splunk instances -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per instance, each with its own base_url and auth token/session key. Managed through connect_splunk / disconnect_splunk -- you should not need to edit this directly.

secrets.name: splunk_hec_tokens
secrets.description: Your saved HTTP Event Collector tokens, one per instance -- stored as a JSON array. Managed through save_hec_token / delete_hec_token.
